html: <sherpa-input-text data-label="Email" name="email" type="email" data-error="Enter an email address.">
<sherpa-input-text data-label="Notify by" name="methods" data-type="tags" value="Email,SMS,Push" placeholder="Add a method">
use: For a typed value with a label, help text and an error message. Set `data-type` to `select` for one of a known set, `number` for a number, `find` to step through the matches a host finds, or `tags` for several words in one field (`value` is the comma string, `.tags` the array); set `data-multiline` for text on more than one line.
